string[] month_names()
    return ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]

string[] weekday_names()
    return ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"]

int[] common_month_days()
    return [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]

const seconds_per_day := 86400
const neg_infinity := -(2 ^ 62)
const pos_infinity := 2 ^ 62

int floor_div(int numerator, int denominator)
    quotient := numerator / denominator
    return if numerator % denominator < 0 then quotient - 1 else quotient

int modulo(int numerator, int denominator)
    return numerator - denominator * floor_div(numerator, denominator)

bool is_leap_year(int year)
    return (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or year % 400 == 0

int days_in_month(int year, int month)
    return if month == 2 and is_leap_year(year) then 29 else common_month_days()[month - 1]

int days_before_year(int year)
    previous := year - 1
    return previous * 365 + floor_div(previous, 4) - floor_div(previous, 100) + floor_div(previous, 400)

int day_number(int year, int month, int day)
    days := days_before_year(year) - days_before_year(1970) + day - 1
    for: 1 <= earlier < month
        days += days_in_month(year, earlier)
    return days

int weekday_of(int number)
    return modulo(number + 4, 7)

class Date(int year, int month, int day)

Date date_of_day(int number)
    year := 1970 + floor_div(number, 366)
    while day_number(year, 1, 1) > number
        year -= 1
    while day_number(year + 1, 1, 1) <= number
        year += 1
    month := 1
    day := number - day_number(year, 1, 1) + 1
    while day > days_in_month(year, month)
        day -= days_in_month(year, month)
        month += 1
    return Date(year, month, day)

int time_value(int year, int month, int day, int hour, int minute, int second)
    return day_number(year, month, day) * seconds_per_day + hour * 3600 + minute * 60 + second

class DateTime(int year, int month, int day, int hour, int minute, int second)

DateTime split_time(int timestamp)
    date := date_of_day(floor_div(timestamp, seconds_per_day))
    seconds := modulo(timestamp, seconds_per_day)
    return DateTime(date.year, date.month, date.day, seconds / 3600, seconds / 60 % 60, seconds % 60)

class DaySpec(string kind, int weekday, int day)
    int value(int year, int month)
        if kind == "last"
            last := day_number(year, month, days_in_month(year, month))
            return last - modulo(weekday_of(last) - weekday, 7)
        base := day_number(year, month, day)
        return if kind == "after" then base + modulo(weekday - weekday_of(base), 7) elif kind == "before" then base - modulo(weekday_of(base) - weekday, 7) else base

import math
import calendar = "./day_rules.qui"
import parser = "./tz_parser.qui"
import transitions = "./transitions.qui"
import resolver = "./resolver.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

string[] read_lines(string path)
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<#lines - 1]

int year_start(int year)
    return calendar.day_number(year, 1, 1) * calendar.seconds_per_day

int clock_seconds(string text)
    return int(text[0:<2]) * 3600 + int(text[3:<5]) * 60

string names_or_none(string[] names, string separator)
    return if #names == 0 then "none" else names.join(separator)

string[] indented(string[] lines)
    return [lines[0]].concat([for line := lines[1:<#lines][] then "  " + line])

class Interval(int low, int high)

Interval[] merge_intervals(Interval[] intervals)
    Interval[] sorted := []
    for piece := intervals[]
        position := int(#sorted)
        sorted = sorted.append(piece)
        while position > 0 and (piece.low < sorted[position - 1].low or (piece.low == sorted[position - 1].low and piece.high < sorted[position - 1].high))
            sorted[position] = sorted[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        sorted[position] = piece
    Interval[] merged := []
    for piece := sorted[]
        last := int(#merged) - 1
        if last >= 0 and piece.low <= merged[last].high
            merged[last].high = math.max(merged[last].high, piece.high)
        else
            merged = merged.append(piece)
    return merged

Interval[] intersect_intervals(Interval[] first, Interval[] second)
    Interval[] pieces := []
    for a := first[]
        for b := second[]
            low := math.max(a.low, b.low)
            high := math.min(a.high, b.high)
            if low < high
                pieces = pieces.append(Interval(low, high))
    return merge_intervals(pieces)

class ZoneLine(int stdoff, string rules_text, string rule_set, int save, string format_text, parser.Until | none until)
    int start := calendar.neg_infinity
    int end := calendar.pos_infinity

    string rules_notation()
        return if rule_set != "" then rule_set elif rules_text == "-" then "-" else report.clock_text(save)

    string until_notation()
        match until
            parser.Until boundary
                return "{boundary.year_text} {boundary.month_text} {boundary.day_text} {report.clock_text(boundary.clock)}{boundary.time_type}"
            none
                return ""

ZoneLine | error parse_zone_line(string[] fields)
    stdoff := try parser.parse_stdoff(fields[0])
    rules_text := fields[1]
    rule_set := ""
    save := 0
    if parser.is_number(rules_text[0], 1, 1)
        save = try parser.parse_save(rules_text)
    elif rules_text != "-"
        rule_set = rules_text
    try parser.check_format(fields[2], rule_set != "")
    parser.Until | none until := none
    if #fields > 3
        until = try parser.parse_until(fields[3:<#fields])
    return ZoneLine(stdoff, rules_text, rule_set, save, fields[2], until)

class SourceLine(int number, local string content)
    string[] fields := parser.split_fields(content)
    string kind := if parser.is_continuation(content) then "continuation" elif fields[0] == "Rule" or fields[0] == "Zone" or fields[0] == "Link" then fields[0] else "unknown"
    block := -1
    position := 0
    ZoneLine | none zone_line := none
    field_error := false
    problem := ""

    bool accepts_continuation()
        return (kind == "Zone" and #fields >= 6) or (kind == "continuation" and #fields >= 4)

class Block(string name, int number, int[] indices)
    defined := false

transitions.Rule | error parse_rule(SourceLine line)
    fields := line.fields
    from_year := try parser.parse_year(fields[2])
    to_year := try parser.parse_to(fields[3], from_year)
    if fields[4] != "-"
        return error("syntax error")
    month := try parser.parse_month(fields[5])
    day := try parser.parse_day_spec(fields[6], month)
    parser.Time at := try parser.parse_time(fields[7])
    save := try parser.parse_save(fields[8])
    letter := try parser.parse_letter(fields[9])
    return transitions.Rule(line.number, fields, from_year, to_year, month, day, at.value, at.kind, save, letter)

transitions.Rule[] rules_named(map<string, transitions.Rule[]> groups, string name)
    match groups.get(name)
        transitions.Rule[] found
            return found
        none
            return []

transitions.RuleInstance[] sequence_named(map<string, transitions.RuleInstance[]> sequences, string name)
    match sequences.get(name)
        transitions.RuleInstance[] found
            return found
        none
            return []

ZoneLine | error zone_value(SourceLine line)
    match line.zone_line
        ZoneLine parsed
            return parsed
        none
            return error("missing zone fields")

string field_problem(SourceLine &line, map<string, transitions.Rule[]> &groups)
    size := int(#line.fields)
    if line.kind == "unknown" or (line.kind == "continuation" and line.block < 0)
        return "syntax error"
    if (line.kind == "Rule" and size != 10) or (line.kind == "Zone" and not (5 <= size <= 9)) or (line.kind == "continuation" and not (3 <= size <= 7)) or (line.kind == "Link" and size != 3)
        return "syntax error"
    if line.kind == "Rule"
        match parse_rule(line)
            transitions.Rule parsed
                members := rules_named(groups, parsed.name)
                .groups.set(parsed.name, members.append(parsed))
            error failure
                return failure.message
    elif line.kind == "Zone" or line.kind == "continuation"
        fields := if line.kind == "Zone" then line.fields[2:<#line.fields] else line.fields
        match parse_zone_line(fields)
            ZoneLine parsed
                line.zone_line = parsed
            error failure
                return failure.message
    return ""

string structural_problem(SourceLine line, SourceLine[] all_lines, Block[] blocks, map<string, transitions.Rule[]> groups, distinct<string> &seen_names)
    parsed := zone_value(line)
    if line.kind == "Zone"
        name := line.fields[1]
        if seen_names.has(name)
            return "duplicate zone " + name
        .seen_names.add(name)
    if parsed.rule_set != "" and not groups.has(parsed.rule_set)
        return "unknown rule " + parsed.rule_set
    match parsed.until
        parser.Until boundary
            block := blocks[line.block]
            if line.kind == "continuation"
                previous := all_lines[block.indices[line.position - 1]]
                if not previous.field_error
                    earlier := zone_value(previous)
                    match earlier.until
                        parser.Until prior
                            if boundary.value <= prior.value
                                return "until not increasing"
                        none
                            return "until not increasing"
            if line.position == int(#block.indices) - 1
                return "missing continuation"
        none
            return ""
    return ""

class Zone(string name, ZoneLine[] lines)
    string[] aliases := []
    applied := map<int, int>()
    timeline := resolver.Timeline([])

    string[] rule_sets()
        string[] names := []
        distinct<string> seen
        for entry := lines[]
            if entry.rule_set != "" and not seen.has(entry.rule_set)
                names = names.append(entry.rule_set)
                .seen.add(entry.rule_set)
        return names

    int line_number_at(int timestamp)
        for: index < int(#lines)
            if lines[index].start <= timestamp < lines[index].end
                return index + 1
        return -1

string standard_letter(transitions.RuleInstance[] instances)
    for instance := instances[]
        if instance.rule.save == 0
            return instance.rule.letter
    return ""

Zone make_zone(Block block, SourceLine[] all_lines, map<string, transitions.RuleInstance[]> sequences)
    ZoneLine[] entries := [for index := block.indices[] then zone_value(all_lines[index])]
    zone := Zone(block.name, entries)
    resolver.Period[] switches := []
    int start := calendar.neg_infinity
    for: index < int(#zone.lines)
        entry := zone.lines[index]
        entry.start = start
        starting_save := entry.save
        starting_letter := ""
        transitions.Applied[] applied_instances := []
        if entry.rule_set == ""
            match entry.until
                parser.Until boundary
                    entry.end = boundary.value - transitions.adjustment(boundary.time_type, entry.stdoff, entry.save)
                none
                    entry.end = calendar.pos_infinity
        else
            instances := sequence_named(sequences, entry.rule_set)
            run := transitions.run_instances(instances, entry.stdoff, start, entry.until)
            entry.end = run.end
            if #run.pre_start > 0
                transitions.Rule last := run.pre_start[-1]
                starting_save = last.save
                starting_letter = last.letter
            else
                starting_save = 0
                starting_letter = standard_letter(instances)
            applied_instances = run.applied
        switches = switches.append(resolver.Period(start, entry.stdoff + starting_save, starting_save != 0, transitions.abbreviation(entry.format_text, starting_save, starting_letter)))
        for applied_instance := applied_instances[]
            transitions.Rule rule := applied_instance.rule
            switches = switches.append(resolver.Period(applied_instance.timestamp, entry.stdoff + rule.save, rule.save != 0, transitions.abbreviation(entry.format_text, rule.save, rule.letter)))
            old_count := 0
            match zone.applied.get(rule.number)
                int found
                    old_count = found
                none
                    old_count = 0
            .zone.applied.set(rule.number, old_count + 1)
        start = entry.end
        zone.lines[index] = entry
    resolver.Period[] periods := []
    for period := switches[]
        if #periods == 0 or not periods[-1].same_state(period)
            periods = periods.append(period)
    zone.timeline = resolver.Timeline(periods)
    return zone

int lookup_index(map<string, int> indices, string name)
    match indices.get(name)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return -1

class Database(local string[] raw_lines)
    SourceLine[] lines := []
    Block[] blocks := []
    rules := map<string, transitions.Rule[]>()
    sequences := map<string, transitions.RuleInstance[]>()
    Zone[] zones := []
    zone_ids := map<string, int>()
    alias_ids := map<string, int>()
    for: index < int(#raw_lines)
        content := parser.line_content(raw_lines[index])
        if content != ""
            lines = lines.append(SourceLine(index + 1, content))
    local previous := -1
    for: index < int(#lines)
        if lines[index].kind == "Zone"
            lines[index].block = int(#blocks)
            blocks = blocks.append(Block(lines[index].fields[1], lines[index].number, [index]))
        elif lines[index].kind == "continuation" and previous >= 0
            block_index := lines[previous].block
            if block_index >= 0 and lines[previous].accepts_continuation()
                lines[index].block = block_index
                lines[index].position = int(#blocks[block_index].indices)
                blocks[block_index].indices = blocks[block_index].indices.append(index)
        previous = index
    for: index < int(#lines)
        failure := field_problem(&lines[index], &rules)
        lines[index].problem = failure
        lines[index].field_error = failure != ""
    local distinct<string> seen_zone_names
    for: index < int(#lines)
        if not lines[index].field_error and (lines[index].kind == "Zone" or lines[index].kind == "continuation")
            lines[index].problem = structural_problem(lines[index], lines, blocks, rules, &seen_zone_names)
    for name := rules.keys()[]
        .sequences.set(name, transitions.instance_sequence(rules_named(rules, name)))
    for: block_index < int(#blocks)
        valid := true
        for index := blocks[block_index].indices[]
            if lines[index].problem != ""
                valid = false
        blocks[block_index].defined = valid
        if valid
            zone := make_zone(blocks[block_index], lines, sequences)
            .zone_ids.set(zone.name, int(#zones))
            zones = zones.append(zone)
    for: index < int(#lines)
        if lines[index].kind == "Link" and lines[index].problem == ""
            target := lines[index].fields[1]
            alias := lines[index].fields[2]
            zone_index := lookup_index(zone_ids, target)
            if zone_index < 0
                lines[index].problem = "unknown link target " + target
            elif zone_ids.has(alias) or alias_ids.has(alias)
                lines[index].problem = "duplicate link " + alias
            else
                .alias_ids.set(alias, zone_index)
                zones[zone_index].aliases = zones[zone_index].aliases.append(alias)

    int find_zone(string word)
        direct := lookup_index(zone_ids, word)
        return if direct >= 0 then direct else lookup_index(alias_ids, word)

    string[] error_lines()
        return [for line := lines[] if line.problem != "" then "line {line.number}: {line.problem}"]

int offset_shift(resolver.Timeline timeline, int index)
    return timeline.periods[index].offset - timeline.periods[index - 1].offset

int[] transitions_between(resolver.Timeline timeline, int low, int high)
    return [for index := (1:<int(#timeline.periods))[] if low <= timeline.starts[index] < high then index]

string change_at(resolver.Timeline timeline, int index)
    return report.change_text(timeline.starts[index], timeline.periods[index - 1], timeline.periods[index])

string transition_line(resolver.Timeline timeline, int index)
    timestamp := timeline.starts[index]
    shift := offset_shift(timeline, index)
    kind := if shift > 0 then "gap " + report.duration_text(shift) elif shift < 0 then "overlap " + report.duration_text(-shift) else "no shift"
    local_before := report.local_text(timestamp + timeline.periods[index - 1].offset)
    local_after := report.local_text(timestamp + timeline.periods[index].offset)
    return "{change_at(timeline, index)} (local {local_before} -> {local_after}, {kind})"

string shifts_text(resolver.Timeline timeline, int[] indices)
    gaps := 0
    overlaps := 0
    unchanged := 0
    for index := indices[]
        shift := offset_shift(timeline, index)
        if shift > 0
            gaps += 1
        elif shift < 0
            overlaps += 1
        else
            unchanged += 1
    return "gaps {gaps}, overlaps {overlaps}, no shift {unchanged}"

string candidate_text(resolver.Timeline timeline, int local_time, int index)
    resolver.Period period := timeline.periods[index]
    return "{report.ut_text(local_time - period.offset)} ({report.state_text(period)})"

int chosen_candidate(int[] candidates, string option)
    return if #candidates == 1 then candidates[0] elif #candidates == 2 and option == "EARLIER" then candidates[0] elif #candidates == 2 and option == "LATER" then candidates[1] else -1

string unresolved_text(resolver.Timeline timeline, int local_time, int[] candidates)
    if #candidates > 0
        return "AMBIGUOUS " + [for index := candidates[] then candidate_text(timeline, local_time, index)].join(" or ")
    index := timeline.skipping_transition(local_time)
    timestamp := timeline.starts[index]
    local_before := report.local_text(timestamp + timeline.periods[index - 1].offset)
    local_after := report.local_text(timestamp + timeline.periods[index].offset)
    return "NONEXISTENT gap {local_before} to {local_after} at {report.ut_text(timestamp)}"

Interval[] working_hours(resolver.Timeline timeline, int start, int end)
    Interval[] pieces := []
    for index := timeline.nearby(start, end)[]
        int offset := timeline.periods[index].offset
        low := math.max(start - offset, timeline.starts[index])
        high := math.min(end - offset, timeline.end_of(index))
        if low < high
            pieces = pieces.append(Interval(low, high))
    return merge_intervals(pieces)

int | none parse_value(string kind, string word)
    year := int(word[0:<4])
    if not (1800 <= year <= 2099)
        return none
    if kind == "year"
        return year
    month := int(word[5:<7])
    day := int(word[8:<10])
    if not (1 <= month <= 12) or not (1 <= day <= calendar.days_in_month(year, month))
        return none
    if kind == "date"
        return calendar.day_number(year, month, day)
    hour := int(word[11:<13])
    minute := int(word[14:<16])
    second := int(word[17:<19])
    if hour > 23 or minute > 59 or second > 59
        return none
    return calendar.time_value(year, month, day, hour, minute, second)

string[] argument_kinds(string command, int count)
    if command == "MEETING"
        return ["date"].concat(array(nat(count - 1), fill = "zone"))
    if command == "TOUTC"
        return ["zone", "local"]
    if command == "TOLOCAL" or command == "OFFSET"
        return ["zone", "ut"]
    if command == "CONVERT"
        return ["zone", "zone", "local"]
    if command == "TRANSITIONS"
        return ["zone", "year", "year"]
    return ["zone", "local", "local"]

class QueryRunner(Database database, int work_start, int work_end)
    string[] answers := []
    string[][] transition_blocks := []

    void .run_query(string query_line)
        words := query_line.split(" ")
        command := words[0]
        arguments := words[1:<#words]
        option := ""
        last := arguments[-1]
        if (command == "TOUTC" or command == "CONVERT") and (last == "EARLIER" or last == "LATER")
            option = last
            arguments = arguments[0:<#arguments - 1]
        kinds := argument_kinds(command, int(#arguments))
        int[] values := []
        failure := ""
        for: index < int(#arguments)
            word := arguments[index]
            if kinds[index] == "zone"
                zone_index := database.find_zone(word)
                if zone_index < 0
                    failure = "unknown zone " + word
                    break
                values = values.append(zone_index)
            else
                parsed := 0
                valid := false
                match parse_value(kinds[index], word)
                    int found
                        parsed = found
                        valid = true
                    none
                        valid = false
                if not valid
                    failure = "invalid value " + word
                    break
                values = values.append(parsed)
        result := ""
        if failure != ""
            result = "ERROR " + failure
        else
            result = .answer(query_line, command, values, arguments, option)
        answers = answers.append(query_line + " => " + result)

    string .answer(string query_line, string command, int[] values, string[] words, string option)
        if command == "TOUTC"
            return to_utc(database.zones[values[0]], values[1], option)
        if command == "TOLOCAL"
            return to_local(database.zones[values[0]], values[1])
        if command == "CONVERT"
            return convert(database.zones[values[0]], database.zones[values[1]], values[2], option)
        if command == "OFFSET"
            return offset(database.zones[values[0]], values[1])
        if command == "TRANSITIONS"
            if values[1] > values[2]
                return "ERROR invalid range"
            resolver.Timeline timeline := database.zones[values[0]].timeline
            selected := transitions_between(timeline, year_start(values[1]), year_start(values[2] + 1))
            string[] block := [query_line].concat([for index := selected[] then transition_line(timeline, index)]).append(shifts_text(timeline, selected))
            transition_blocks = transition_blocks.append(block)
            return "transitions: {#selected}"
        if command == "DURATION"
            return duration(database.zones[values[0]], values[1:<#values], words[1:<#words])
        return meeting(values[0], values[1:<#values], words[1:<#words])

    string to_utc(Zone zone, int local_time, string option)
        int[] candidates := zone.timeline.candidates(local_time)
        index := chosen_candidate(candidates, option)
        return if index < 0 then unresolved_text(zone.timeline, local_time, candidates) else candidate_text(zone.timeline, local_time, index)

    string to_local(Zone zone, int timestamp)
        resolver.Period period := zone.timeline.period_at(timestamp)
        return "{report.local_text(timestamp + period.offset)} ({report.state_text(period)})"

    string convert(Zone source_zone, Zone target_zone, int local_time, string option)
        int[] candidates := source_zone.timeline.candidates(local_time)
        index := chosen_candidate(candidates, option)
        if index < 0
            return unresolved_text(source_zone.timeline, local_time, candidates)
        int timestamp := local_time - source_zone.timeline.periods[index].offset
        resolver.Period period := target_zone.timeline.period_at(timestamp)
        target_local := timestamp + period.offset
        shift := calendar.floor_div(target_local, calendar.seconds_per_day) - calendar.floor_div(local_time, calendar.seconds_per_day)
        shift_text := if shift > 0 then "+{shift}" else "{shift}"
        return "{report.local_text(target_local)} ({report.state_text(period)}) at {report.ut_text(timestamp)}, day shift {shift_text}"

    string offset(Zone zone, int timestamp)
        resolver.Timeline timeline := zone.timeline
        index := timeline.index_at(timestamp)
        text := report.state_text(timeline.periods[index])
        if index >= 1
            text += " since " + report.ut_text(timeline.starts[index])
        if index + 1 < int(#timeline.periods)
            text += " until " + report.ut_text(timeline.starts[index + 1])
        return text

    string duration(Zone zone, int[] locals, string[] words)
        resolver.Period[] periods := []
        for: index < 2
            int[] candidates := zone.timeline.candidates(locals[index])
            if #candidates == 2
                return "AMBIGUOUS " + words[index]
            if #candidates == 0
                return "NONEXISTENT " + words[index]
            periods = periods.append(zone.timeline.periods[candidates[0]])
        elapsed := (locals[1] - periods[1].offset) - (locals[0] - periods[0].offset)
        change := periods[1].offset - periods[0].offset
        return "{elapsed} s ({report.duration_text(elapsed)}), wall clock {report.duration_text(locals[1] - locals[0])}, offset change {report.offset_text(change)}"

    string meeting(int day, int[] zone_indices, string[] words)
        int start := day * calendar.seconds_per_day + work_start
        int end := day * calendar.seconds_per_day + work_end
        common := working_hours(database.zones[zone_indices[0]].timeline, start, end)
        for: 1 <= index < int(#zone_indices)
            common = intersect_intervals(common, working_hours(database.zones[zone_indices[index]].timeline, start, end))
        if #common == 0
            return "NONE"
        string[] parts := []
        for piece := common[]
            string[] members := []
            for: index < int(#zone_indices)
                resolver.Period period := database.zones[zone_indices[index]].timeline.period_at(piece.low)
                members = members.append("{words[index]} {report.local_text(piece.low + period.offset)} {period.abbreviation}")
            span := "{report.ut_text(piece.low)} to {report.ut_text(piece.high)} ({report.duration_text(piece.high - piece.low)})"
            parts = parts.append(span + " [" + members.join(", ") + "]")
        return parts.join("; ")

string rule_text(transitions.Rule rule)
    fields := rule.fields
    at := report.clock_text(rule.at) + rule.at_type
    return "rule {rule.name} {fields[2]} {fields[3]} {fields[5]} {fields[6]} {at} {report.clock_text(rule.save)} {fields[9]}"

string[] database_block(Database database)
    valid_rules := 0
    invalid_rules := 0
    valid_links := 0
    invalid_links := 0
    for line := database.lines[]
        if line.kind == "Rule"
            if line.problem == ""
                valid_rules += 1
            else
                invalid_rules += 1
        if line.kind == "Link"
            if line.problem == ""
                valid_links += 1
            else
                invalid_links += 1
    distinct<string> used
    zone_lines := 0
    for zone := database.zones[]
        zone_lines += int(#zone.lines)
        for name := zone.rule_sets()[]
            .used.add(name)
    unused := [for name := database.rules.keys()[] if not used.has(name) then name]
    invalid := [for block := database.blocks[] if not block.defined then "{block.name} (line {block.number})"]
    lines := [
        "DATABASE", "rule lines: {valid_rules} valid, {invalid_rules} invalid",
        "zones: {#database.zones} defined, {int(#database.blocks) - int(#database.zones)} invalid",
        "zone lines: {zone_lines} in defined zones", "links: {valid_links} defined, {invalid_links} invalid", "errors: {#database.error_lines()}",
        "unused rules: " + names_or_none(unused, " "), "invalid zones: " + names_or_none(invalid, ", ")
    ]
    for name := database.rules.keys()[]
        rules := rules_named(database.rules, name)
        first_year := 2099
        last_year := 1800
        maximum := false
        for rule := rules[]
            first_year = math.min(first_year, rule.from_year)
            last_year = math.max(last_year, rule.to_year)
            maximum = maximum or rule.fields[3] == "max"
        last_text := if maximum then "max" else "{last_year}"
        zone_count := 0
        for zone := database.zones[]
            for used_name := zone.rule_sets()[]
                if used_name == name
                    zone_count += 1
        lines = lines.append("rule set {name}: lines {#rules}, years {first_year}-{last_text}, zones {zone_count}")
    return lines

string[] dst_lines(resolver.Timeline timeline, int reference)
    dst_indices := [for index := (0:<int(#timeline.periods))[] if timeline.periods[index].dst then index]
    string[] lines := []
    if #dst_indices > 0
        years := [for index := dst_indices[] then calendar.split_time(timeline.starts[index]).year]
        lines = lines.append("dst years: {years.min()}-{years.max()}")
    else
        lines = lines.append("dst years: none")
    year := calendar.split_time(reference).year
    low := year_start(year)
    high := year_start(year + 1)
    Interval[] pieces := []
    for index := dst_indices[]
        start := math.max(low, timeline.starts[index])
        end := math.min(high, timeline.end_of(index))
        if start < end
            pieces = pieces.append(Interval(start, end))
    total := 0
    for piece := merge_intervals(pieces)[]
        lines = lines.append("dst period: {report.ut_text(piece.low)} to {report.ut_text(piece.high)} ({report.duration_text(piece.high - piece.low)})")
        total += piece.high - piece.low
    return lines.append("dst total {year}: {report.duration_text(total)}")

string[] zone_block(Database database, Zone zone, int reference)
    resolver.Timeline timeline := zone.timeline
    resolver.Period[] periods := timeline.periods
    lines := ["ZONE " + zone.name, "aliases: " + names_or_none(zone.aliases, " ")]
    for: index < int(#zone.lines)
        entry := zone.lines[index]
        text := "line {index + 1}: {report.offset_text(entry.stdoff)} {entry.rules_notation()} {entry.format_text}"
        if index >= 1
            text += " from " + report.ut_text(entry.start)
        match entry.until
            parser.Until boundary
                text += " until {entry.until_notation()} = {report.ut_text(entry.end)}"
            none
                text += ""
        count := int(#transitions_between(timeline, entry.start, entry.end))
        lines = lines.append("{text}, transitions {count}")
    for name := zone.rule_sets()[]
        for rule := rules_named(database.rules, name)[]
            count := 0
            match zone.applied.get(rule.number)
                int found
                    count = found
                none
                    count = 0
            lines = lines.append("{rule_text(rule)}, applied {count}")
    offsets := [for period := periods[] then period.offset]
    lines = lines.append("offset range: {report.offset_text(offsets.min())} to {report.offset_text(offsets.max())}")
    map<string, int> state_counts
    for period := periods[]
        state := report.state_text(period)
        count := 0
        match state_counts.get(state)
            int found
                count = found
            none
                count = 0
        .state_counts.set(state, count + 1)
    for state := state_counts.keys()[]
        count := lookup_index(state_counts, state)
        lines = lines.append("state {state}, periods {count}")
    reference_index := timeline.index_at(reference)
    reference_period := periods[reference_index]
    lines = lines.append("reference: {report.local_text(reference + reference_period.offset)} ({report.state_text(reference_period)}), line {zone.line_number_at(reference)}")
    previous_change := if reference_index >= 1 then change_at(timeline, reference_index) else "none"
    next_change := if reference_index + 1 < int(#periods) then change_at(timeline, reference_index + 1) else "none"
    lines = lines.append("previous transition: " + previous_change).append("next transition: " + next_change)
    every := (1:<int(#periods))
    lines = lines.append("transitions: {#every}, {shifts_text(timeline, every)}")
    return lines.concat(dst_lines(timeline, reference))

void run_database()
    database := Database(read_lines("input/tzdata.txt"))
    params := read_lines("input/params.txt")
    reference := 0
    match parse_value("ut", params[0].split(" ")[1])
        int found
            reference = found
        none
            reference = 0
    workday := params[1].split(" ")
    runner := QueryRunner(database, clock_seconds(workday[1]), clock_seconds(workday[2]))
    for query_line := read_lines("input/queries.txt")[]
        .runner.run_query(query_line)
    blocks := [indented(database_block(database))]
    for name := database.zone_ids.keys().sorted()[]
        zone_index := lookup_index(database.zone_ids, name)
        blocks = blocks.append(indented(zone_block(database, database.zones[zone_index], reference)))
    bool directory_exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not directory_exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    report.write_lines("answers.txt", runner.answers)
    report.write_lines("errors.txt", database.error_lines())
    report.write_blocks("transitions.txt", runner.transition_blocks)
    report.write_blocks("zone_summary.txt", blocks)

if main
    run_database()

import math
import calendar = "./day_rules.qui"
import resolver = "./resolver.qui"

string local_text(int timestamp)
    parts := calendar.split_time(timestamp)
    return "{parts.year:04.}-{parts.month:02.}-{parts.day:02.}T{parts.hour:02.}:{parts.minute:02.}:{parts.second:02.}"

string ut_text(int timestamp)
    return local_text(timestamp) + "Z"

string offset_text(int value)
    sign := if value < 0 then "-" else "+"
    magnitude := math.abs(value)
    hours := magnitude / 3600
    minutes := magnitude / 60 % 60
    seconds := magnitude % 60
    text := "{sign}{hours:02.}:{minutes:02.}"
    return if seconds != 0 then text + ":{seconds:02.}" else text

string duration_text(int value)
    sign := if value < 0 then "-" else ""
    magnitude := math.abs(value)
    hours := magnitude / 3600
    minutes := magnitude / 60 % 60
    seconds := magnitude % 60
    return "{sign}{hours}:{minutes:02.}:{seconds:02.}"

string clock_text(int value)
    hours := value / 3600
    minutes := value / 60 % 60
    seconds := value % 60
    text := "{hours}:{minutes:02.}"
    return if seconds != 0 then text + ":{seconds:02.}" else text

string state_text(resolver.Period period)
    kind := if period.dst then "DST" else "STD"
    return "{offset_text(period.offset)} {kind} {period.abbreviation}"

string change_text(int timestamp, resolver.Period before, resolver.Period after)
    return "{ut_text(timestamp)} {state_text(before)} -> {state_text(after)}"

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

void write_blocks(string name, string[][] blocks)
    string[] lines := []
    for block := blocks[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(block)
    write_lines(name, lines)

import calendar = "./day_rules.qui"

class Period(int start, int offset, bool dst, string abbreviation)
    bool same_state(Period other)
        return offset == other.offset and dst == other.dst and abbreviation == other.abbreviation

class Timeline(Period[] periods)
    int[] starts := [for period := periods[] then period.start]

    int index_at(int timestamp)
        low := 0
        high := int(#starts)
        while low < high
            middle := (low + high) / 2
            if starts[middle] <= timestamp
                low = middle + 1
            else
                high = middle
        return low - 1

    Period period_at(int timestamp)
        return periods[index_at(timestamp)]

    int end_of(int index)
        return if index + 1 < int(#periods) then starts[index + 1] else calendar.pos_infinity

    int[] nearby(int first_local, int last_local)
        int first := index_at(first_local - 57600)
        int last := index_at(last_local + 57600)
        return (first:last)

    int[] candidates(int local_time)
        int[] found := []
        for index := nearby(local_time, local_time)[]
            timestamp := local_time - periods[index].offset
            if starts[index] <= timestamp < end_of(index)
                found = found.append(index)
        return found

    int skipping_transition(int local_time)
        for index := nearby(local_time, local_time)[]
            if index > 0 and starts[index] + periods[index - 1].offset <= local_time < starts[index] + periods[index].offset
                return index
        return -1

import calendar = "./day_rules.qui"
import parser = "./tz_parser.qui"

class Rule(int number, string[] fields, int from_year, int to_year, int month, calendar.DaySpec day, int at, string at_type, int save, string letter)
    string name := fields[1]

class RuleInstance(Rule rule, int nominal)

RuleInstance | error instance_for(map<int, RuleInstance> by_key, int key)
    match by_key.get(key)
        RuleInstance found
            return found
        none
            return error("missing rule instance")

RuleInstance[] instance_sequence(Rule[] rules)
    RuleInstance[] instances := []
    for rule := rules[]
        for: rule.from_year <= year <= rule.to_year
            int nominal := rule.day.value(year, rule.month) * calendar.seconds_per_day + rule.at
            instances = instances.append(RuleInstance(rule, nominal))
    stride := 401
    keys := [for instance := instances[] then instance.nominal * stride + instance.rule.number]
    ordering := keys.sorted()
    map<int, RuleInstance> by_key
    for: index < int(#instances)
        .by_key.set(keys[index], instances[index])
    return [for key := ordering[] then instance_for(by_key, key)]

int adjustment(string time_type, int stdoff, int save)
    return if time_type == "u" then 0 elif time_type == "s" then stdoff else stdoff + save

class Applied(int timestamp, Rule rule)
class LineRun(Rule[] pre_start, Applied[] applied, int end)

LineRun run_instances(RuleInstance[] instances, int stdoff, int start, parser.Until | none until)
    Rule[] pre_start := []
    Applied[] applied := []
    save := 0
    int end := calendar.pos_infinity
    for instance := instances[]
        rule := instance.rule
        timestamp := instance.nominal - adjustment(rule.at_type, stdoff, save)
        stop := false
        match until
            parser.Until boundary
                stop = timestamp >= boundary.value - adjustment(boundary.time_type, stdoff, save)
            none
                stop = false
        if stop
            break
        if timestamp <= start
            pre_start = pre_start.append(rule)
        else
            applied = applied.append(Applied(timestamp, rule))
        save = rule.save
    match until
        parser.Until boundary
            end = boundary.value - adjustment(boundary.time_type, stdoff, save)
        none
            end = calendar.pos_infinity
    return LineRun(pre_start, applied, end)

string abbreviation(string format_text, int save, string letter)
    if format_text.contains("/")
        parts := format_text.split("/")
        return if save != 0 then parts[1] else parts[0]
    return format_text.split("%s").join(letter)
